Anika: Dropping a quick Q&A follow-up from todays all-hands re: customer wins/losses and how we feed signals back. Please add 1-line facts or asks only.
Raj: Loss highlight 45min call w/retail analytics team. Main reason: pricing model mismatch for seasonal burst traffic & no easy quota cap UI. They wanted per-team caps.
Leila: CS follow-up: they also flagged lack of per-route cost analytics; ops couldn't prove we wouldnt blow budget. Added to churn log.
Marco: Eng note: per-route billing dashboard is doable but needs event-schemas + sampling. Estimate 3 weeks dev + 1 week infra testing.
Priya: Win: 2 infra-heavy SaaS customers signed on Dedicated after seeing consistent p95 and tail latency numbers in our benchmark. They cited capacity pre-warm and autoscale rules as decision factors.
Dan: Sales signal: top asks across SMB to mid-market are simple: 1) self-serve predictable pricing tiers, 2) SSO, 3) longer retention window for logs.
Leila: Also a pattern: a few customers asked for on-prem proof-of-concept for regulated workloads. They want a short checklist for compliance questions.
Raj: Lost one PoC because our onboarding required feature toggles handled by engineering. They wanted quicker config via Console.
Anika: So proposed immediate items: console-level feature toggles, basic per-route cost view, SSO/SAML. Which of these can we ship as quick wins?
Marco: Quick wins: console toggles + per-route sampling dashboard prototype. SAML needs security review but we can scope an MVP.
Priya: I'll draft a one-page "decision drivers" playbook for AEs summarizing why customers sign (latency, cost predictability, capacity controls) and common objections.
Leila: CS will prepare a churn interview template to capture exact phrasing from lost pilots (2-question quick survey).
Dan: Can sales attach ballpark traffic numbers to each open deal? Marco/Infra need that to size pre-warm pools.
Anika: Action owners: Marco (scope + ETA for toggles & dashboard), Priya (playbook), Leila (churn survey), Raj (catalog lost pilots + reasons). Post updates in this thread by EOD Wednesday.
all-hands-bot: Notes & action tracker created  https://redwood.company/notes/allhands-1766001122/actions
Anika: Thanks everyone. Keep bullets short here, especially if you spot repeat asks across accounts. :)
